race.comment: SIXTY GRAND (9) produced an eye-catcher last time out over a similar distance at Mornington, chiming in late to be beaten narrowly after looking no hope. Has not raced for five weeks but trust the Price/Kent yard has kept him up to the mark. Promising stayer with definite claims. LIMOSA (14) has come from a long way back at her last two runs, both over 1700m at Warrnambool, for a second and a fourth. Crying out for this sort of trip now. YOROKOBI (10) led for home but found one better near the line over 1600m at Balaklava last start. Is a winner at this trip so he should continue the outstanding run of recent form. SUIT OF WANDS (12) won't mind coming back a little in trip and is a chance on what we have seen of late.
